verdict.rationale: Data stored in AI Object Storage can be retrieved over S3-compatible access and downloaded from the Cloud Console. Usage and billing data can be exported programmatically through the FOCUS API, an open FinOps format, though that API is still in Public Preview. Infrastructure runs on standard Kubernetes and Terraform/OpenTofu, which keeps workloads portable, but nothing documents a complete account export or offboarding path. Missing for 10: a documented export of all account data, migration/offboarding guidance, egress terms, a generally available (non-preview) FOCUS export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of leaving the platform.
